description: This file defines structures, enums, macros, and function prototypes related to IEEE 802.15.4 MAC frames, including frame types, addressing modes, security features, and frame construction/validation functions. It is intended for internal use within the network stack implementation, not for application inclusion.

methods.name: ieee802154_validate_aux_security_hdr
methods.description: Validates and parses the auxiliary security header from a buffer.

methods.name: ieee802154_validate_fc_seq
methods.description: Validates and parses the Frame Control Field and sequence number from a buffer.

methods.name: ieee802154_create_data_frame
methods.description: Constructs a data frame with specified parameters.

methods.name: ieee802154_create_mac_cmd_frame
methods.description: Creates a MAC command frame of a specified type.

methods.name: ieee802154_mac_cmd_finalize
methods.description: Finalizes a MAC command frame before transmission.

methods.name: ieee802154_decipher_data_frame
methods.description: Deciphers an encrypted data frame if security is enabled.
